name: 소보로 플러스 (Sovoro Plus)
oneLine: A Korean caption service from Seoul for deaf and hard of hearing people and older Koreans with hearing loss: live captions on phone, tablet and a PC browser, file captions with speaker separation, and a typed-text-to-AI-voice conversation mode, after a 14-day free trial.

platforms.text: iPhone, iPad, Android, PC web browser
platforms.detail: Apps for iPhone, iPad and Android, plus the web app in a PC browser, all on one account (phone, tablet, laptop, desktop). The mobile app can be signed in on two devices at once. The App Store also lists it for Macs with Apple M1 or later.

deviceRequirements.detail: iPhone and iPad need iOS 16 or later; a Mac needs macOS 13 and an Apple M1 chip or later. The KEAD-funded bundle recommends Android 13 or later.

roomCaptions.detail: Live captions for everyday conversations, lectures and meetings on phone, tablet or PC. Each live session runs for up to 120 minutes. For noise or a distant speaker, Sovoro suggests connecting a microphone.

groupConversations.detail: Meetings and lectures are captioned from one device, with a connected microphone suggested when the speaker is far away or the room is noisy. The KEAD bundle comes with a wireless clip mic and an omnidirectional mic. Speaker separation is described for uploaded files, not live captions.

languages.detail: The mobile guide lists Korean, English and Japanese as caption languages. Chinese captions were removed from the iPhone app in January 2025. The app itself is in Korean only.

offline.detail: Sovoro's pages don't describe captions without internet. The store listing says caption accuracy depends on the network, among other things.

speakerLabels.detail: Captions for uploaded audio and video come with speaker separation. The pages don't say live captions show who is talking.

voiceNames.detail: No page describes learning people's voices or showing their names.

speakerDirection.detail: No page describes showing where a voice comes from.

translation.text: No, captions stay in the spoken language
translation.detail: You choose the recognition language, and captions come out in that language, not as a translation.

saveTranscripts.text: Yes, synced; audio too on mobile
saveTranscripts.detail: On mobile you can save the captions, or the captions with the audio. On the web only the captions are saved. Saved captions show on your other devices.

export.detail: Saved captions can be viewed, downloaded and managed from storage, edited in a web editor while you listen again, and saved as a text file to share.

fileUpload.detail: Upload audio or video (aac, wav, mp3, m4a, ac3, flac, avi, mp4, mov, wmv), such as call recordings, meetings or lectures, and get captions with speaker separation. File captions are limited to 10 hours a month.

summaries.detail: Sovoro's feature lists on its website and App Store page don't mention AI summaries or notes from a transcript.

customWords.detail: Sovoro ended its word list (단어장), which helped recognise words you added, on 11 June 2024, after an accuracy update.

display.text: Colours, size, fonts; PC pop-up window
display.detail: Caption colour, size and font can be changed, swear words can be hidden, and on the web a pop-up caption window can be placed and resized anywhere on the screen.

soundAlerts.detail: Sovoro's feature lists on its website and App Store page don't mention alerts for sounds like a doorbell or an alarm.

phoneCalls.detail: The mobile guide says call captions aren't possible. Recorded calls can be uploaded as files and captioned.

videoCalls.detail: On PC the web app captions sound playing on the computer, but the pages don't mention video calls such as Zoom.

mediaOnDevice.detail: Content captions show captions for videos or audio playing on the phone. On PC the web app captions sound playing on the computer, which on Windows needs a separate sound setup (a virtual audio cable).

humanCaptioners.detail: No page describes a person checking or writing the captions.

signLanguage.detail: No page describes sign language. For your side of the conversation there is a typed-text-to-AI-voice mode instead.

privacy.text: Cloud; data processed in the US
privacy.detail: The privacy policy (in force since 14 May 2024) lists Amazon Web Services and Google LLC in the US as processors, and the data sent to Google includes the audio and video files users enter. The App Store label lists audio data linked to you. The app collects an advertising identifier for personalised ads.

account.detail: Sign up with a KakaoTalk or Naver account, or email, in the app or on the website. Sign-up is for ages 14 and up; younger users need a guardian's consent.

availability.text: South Korea; app in Korean only
availability.detail: Made for Korea: the app and its pages are in Korean, with phone support on weekdays. The App Store also lists it outside Korea, for example in the US store.

freePlan.detail: New members get a 14-day free trial of every feature. The website says nothing is charged automatically when it ends; to keep using Sovoro Plus you subscribe.

price.detail: Basic Monthly, KRW 9,900, Korean App Store in-app purchases, November 2026. The App Store listing describes one monthly plan. A 2024 payment guide mentioned monthly and yearly plans on the website; current website prices need a login.

accessibilityFunding.detail: Deaf workers can get the 소보로 노트 bundle (Galaxy Tab A9+, microphones, 3 years of Sovoro) through KEAD's assistive technology programme: KRW 1,013,760, of which KEAD pays KRW 912,384 (all of it for basic livelihood recipients). For students, the SK Happiness Foundation says some provincial education offices support Sovoro Plus as an assistive device.

strengths.text: One account works on phone, tablet and a PC web browser, and the PC version captions videos and lectures playing on the computer in a pop-up window you can move and resize.
A conversation mode reads your typed text aloud in a natural AI voice, with pitch and speed you can set, for deaf people who find speaking hard.
Deaf workers in Korea can get the 소보로 노트 bundle (tablet, microphones and 3 years of Sovoro) with 90% paid by KEAD.
Uploaded audio and video get captions with speaker separation, which you can correct in a web editor.

limits.text: Captions in Korean, English and Japanese only, and no translation between languages.
After the 14-day trial a subscription is needed; no free plan is described.
File captions are limited to 10 hours a month, and each live session to 120 minutes.
The word list for adding your own words ended in June 2024.

notes: Conflicts: (1) Plans: the Korean App Store listing (version 1.1.3, August 2026) describes one monthly auto-renewing plan and lists 'Basic Monthly KRW 9,900'; the support FAQ says subscriptions are monthly; the June 2024 payment guide (s20) described monthly and yearly plans on the website at a launch discount. Website prices need a login and were not seen. (2) Trial: the App Store says a 14-day free trial comes with sign-up and that unused trial days extend the first paid period; the website FAQ says nothing is charged automatically when the trial ends. (3) Students: the SK Happiness Foundation project page (official, used) says 'some' provincial education offices support Sovoro Plus as an assistive device; a January 2026 press article on youthassembly.kr (not used) says all 16 offices list it and lend it free for a year. Sovoro's use-cases page says it is registered as 3 assistive devices (not used). (4) Google Play data safety says no data is shared with third parties; the privacy policy lists processors (entrustment under Korean law) including Google LLC and Amazon Web Services in the US, and third-party provision to the Happiness Foundation for children in its project. The overseas-transfer table in the privacy policy is an image; its text was read from a screenshot. (5) The name differs by store: Korean App Store '소보로 플러스 - 무제한 실시간 자막', US App Store '소보로 플러스 - 말하는 순간, 실시간 자막으로', Google Play '소보로 플러스 - 말하는 순간, 자막으로'. 'Unlimited' in the name sits next to a 120-minute session limit and a 10 hours/month file limit. Accuracy percentages (97%) and institution counts are on the site but not used. Not found: offline use, AI summaries, live speaker labels, sound alerts, sign language, human captioners, the standalone Android app's minimum version, website prices. The old installable PC software is marked discontinued on the web sign-in page. How opened: sovoro.kr is a JavaScript app, read in a browser; Notion pages read in a browser and through Notion's public page data; the KEAD shop page read in a browser; App Store, lookup API, Google Play, KEAD hub with curl. All checked 2026-11-02.
